title: PreExecutionReviewReceipt v1
description: A content-bound verdict on one pre-execution snapshot, with structured findings, reviewer identities, and an optional critique/synthesis topology. This document is a NON-AUTHORITATIVE Draft-07 structural projection generated from the package's canonical pre-execution-contract definition. It is not a semantic authority: a Draft-07 match is not contract validity — use the authoritative runtime entry point named in $comment.

contract.description: Contract identifier. Candidate and verification receipts carry other ids and are refused here.

id.description: Stable receipt identity. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

snapshotDigest.description: Digest of the exact snapshot that was reviewed.

verdict.description: One of the five public verdicts.

findings.description: Structured findings; at most 64. A PASS never carries an open or unverified material row.

reviewer.description: Reviewer identity as the runtime knows it. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

sessionId.description: Session identity of the context-clean review. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

reviewerRole.description: Role this receipt played in the review topology.

authorId.description: Identity of the artifact author the exclusion rule compares against. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

authorExclusion.description: Whether the runtime can actually observe author identity.

contextClean.description: The review ran in a context that did not author the artifact.

modelDiversity.description: Truthful diversity label; never inferred from plurality.

policyVersion.description: Review policy version the verdict was produced under; at most 64 characters.

parentReceipts.description: Optional bounded critique/synthesis/arbitration parents; at most 8. Presence is topology, not a vote.

diagnostics.description: Reviewer-side notes; at most 8 rows of 512 characters.

allOf.description: [verdict-stage-matrix] A SPEC-stage receipt carries only spec verdicts.
[verdict-stage-matrix] A PLAN-stage receipt carries only plan verdicts.
[parent-topology-shaped] Parent receipts require a critic, synthesizer, or arbiter reviewer role.
[parent-topology-restrained] A plain reviewer receipt carries no parent receipts.
[parent-identities-unique] Parent receipts are unique rows; digests are unique too (runtime rule).

id.description: Stable finding identity, unique inside the receipt. Opaque: compared, never parsed, and never echoed back by a diagnostic.

severity.description: Severity ladder shared with candidate review; `info` is the only immaterial row.

class.description: Root-cause owner the finding routes to.

claim.description: What the reviewer asserts is missing or wrong; at most 2048 characters.

evidenceRefs.description: Non-empty file:line references; at most 8. A claim without evidence is not a finding.

verification.description: Whether the claim was checked against the artifact.

resolution.description: Resolution state inside the owning author's repair.

resolutionEvidence.description: Counter-evidence or repair pointer. Required to dismiss or resolve a finding.

allOf.description: [dismissal-needs-counter-evidence] A dismissed finding records the evidence that falsifies it.

role.description: Parent role. No quorum or majority meaning is attached to this list.

receiptDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the parent receipt.
